title: Try the pottery wheel in Santa Fe

location.label: Paseo Pottery, Santa Fe, New Mexico

description: At Paseo Pottery, a local ceramic artist shows you how to center clay and begin shaping it on the wheel. The process is messier and more absorbing than a finished bowl suggests: your hands, the turning wheel, and a little pressure all matter. The studio also displays work by Santa Fe makers, so you can see what practiced hands can do.
teaser: Spend two hands-on hours with clay and a pottery wheel.
whyItMightDelightYou: Even a lopsided first attempt can be satisfying when you feel the clay respond under your fingers.
goodToKnow: Ask about winter workshop dates and a comfortable seated beginner session.
